items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: But all them other Smiths I don't know nothing about them.

ctx.x: And heavy, yeah. Ma Rainey had a terrible voice. Now we had, oh Lord, I can't just think of all them actors naming. I do know a whole lot of them.
Well what about Bessie Smith and Mamie Smith and Trixie Smith and all those women, they all had Smith names, you know?

Well Bessie Smith, Bessie, I know her and she was a blues singer too. But all them other Smiths I don't know nothing about them. I have heard several of them but I don't know too much about them, you know?
